topic: Vehicle Mode and Usage Mode Specification for Interior Lighting
row_semantics: Each row represents a different vehicle or usage mode state, detailing its definition and associated CAN/ICB/ZXD/RZCU/LHZCU input signals.
column_semantics: Columns represent different signal sources (Input, CAN, ICB/ZXD, RZCU/LHZCU) and their corresponding states (VS SST S).

engineering_interpretation: This table specifies the valid states and definitions for Vehicle Mode (VehMd), Vehicle Mode Validity (VehMdV), and Usage Mode (UsGmd) related to interior lighting control. It can be used to verify that the correct mode is recognized and processed by the system under various conditions.
